richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Srikakulam

c: Srikakulam is the northernmost district of Andhra Pradesh, on a coast that takes the full force of Bay of Bengal cyclones every few years. Wind and salt air are what we plan for first as an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Srikakulam. We supply schools, colleges, municipal parks, beachside spaces and government offices from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,160 km away by road.

An outdoor gym here has to stay firmly in the ground through a storm and keep working in humid, salty air for years. That means grouted posts in a solid concrete base, galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts that do not rust. Our team or a dealer in south India installs every machine according to a layout drawing you approve first. Beach roads and seafront parks get the strongest wind, so we take extra care with the foundation at such sites.

richText.heading: Anchoring machines on a cyclone-prone coast

c: For coastal sites we recommend grouting every post rather than using self-standing frames. A deeper concrete foundation holds the machine steady in high winds. Keep the gym away from tall trees that could fall in a storm, and away from loose sand that drifts over the base.

items.q: How are outdoor gym machines secured against cyclones?
items.a: We grout the posts into a concrete foundation on coastal sites. After a storm, check bolts and frames, and call our after-sales team if anything has moved.

items.q: Does salt air damage the equipment?
items.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist corrosion far better than painted mild steel. Rinsing the frames with fresh water from time to time helps them last longer.

items.q: Can you supply a school in a small town in Srikakulam district?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India. Send us the ground size and photos, and we will suggest machines suitable for students and staff.
